conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister, or Coda first.
Ergo Glast never sells the Glaxion — his Corrupted Holokey shop only carries Grigori, Livia, Exec, Agendus and Ferrox. Every ranged Tenet weapon comes from a Sister.

groups.activity: clear the Nightmare Granum Void; inspect Candidates

rows.label: Tenet Glaxion Candidate
rows.note: Mercy only when the weapon preview says Glaxion
rows.alt: buy a converted Tenet Glaxion Sister

rows.label: progenitor element
rows.note: Magnetic keeps Glaxion's innate Cold separate for Corrosive/Radiation modding; Toxin combines to Viral; Heat's resulting Blast wastes multishot on a beam weapon
rows.alt: Elemental Vice can change it later at rank 40

conditions: A Treasurer spawns 2-5 minutes into any non-endless Corpus Ship mission and drops a Crown tiered by level; level 31+ or Steel Path drops the Zenith, the only tier that spawns a Candidate.
Open the Void far from extraction and walk out slowly afterward — within roughly 150-200m of extraction, or sprinting out, suppresses the Candidate spawn entirely.
If the preview isn't Glaxion, leave her and complete and extract from the mission. Aborting does not remove that weapon from the pool; only a completed rejection does.

The Sister-carried pool is 11 weapons (Arca Plasmor, Cycron, Detron, Diplos, Envoy, Flux Rifle, Glaxion, Plinx, Quanta, Spirex, Tetra), so correctly rejecting guarantees Glaxion inside 11 completed missions.
Only the player who dealt the final hit can Mercy, and a Rank 4+ Sister spawns Spectralysts — exact copies of your Warframe and loadout.
bonuses: Xoris, even 0-forma, one-shots Errant Specters regardless of level and frees Solaris captives for +20s each on detonation.

disclosures.title: finish the mission on every reject
disclosures.body: A widely-upvoted 2024 thread documents 10 straight Detron Sisters from a player who kept aborting instead of completing rejected missions. Reject correctly and the Glaxion is guaranteed inside 11.

groups.activity: Mercy Hounds, reveal Requiems, test the sequence
groups.mode: long missions first, then fast ones
conditions: Requiem mods all come from the single Requiem Eterna relic (all 8 mods at equal chance), from Kuva Siphon (50%) or Kuva Flood (100%); the retired Requiem I-IV relics are sold by Palladino for 10 Riven Slivers each, 10 weekly per relic.
Survival, Defense and Excavation on her nodes maximise Hounds per mission (max 3, one always at start); switch to Capture or Exterminate once you only need rage to draw her out.
Hounds take 25% less damage, don't take bonus Toxin damage, cap at 4 status stacks, and can null your ability casts onto cooldown; they only raise her rage meter when killed on her own nodes.
Failing a Parazon attempt levels the Sister up, raising every node she controls; three failed downs in one mission and she leaves.
bonuses: Run the Neptune Proxima confrontation in a full squad: one Corrupted Holokey per member, up to 4.

disclosures.title: Oull-first Parazon
disclosures.body: Slot Oull permanently in position 1 and test each revealed Requiem in position 2. Worst case is 4 attempts without ever learning the third Requiem, and every attempt still spawns Hounds and murmurs. Oull drops from Sister Parazon attempts at 25%.

rows.label: Tenet Glaxion
rows.note: built; Foundry delivery, her Hound fully built too

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert — Convert gives an ally and a tradeable Sister token but no weapon.
Kill her Hounds and both Warframe Specters; she is invulnerable until her backup is dead.
Needs Railjack Intrinsics rank 3; bring a Railjack with actual hull and shield mods.
bonuses: Vanquish also refunds taxed credits, any ephemera, a 25% shot at a Requiem Ultimatum, and one Corrupted Holokey per squad member.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy you've invested in — the donor's Catalyst, Forma, Exilus adapter and Elemental Vice are all destroyed.
Elemental Vice needs rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, 20 platinum from the Market, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.
bonuses: Photon Overcharge, the Glaxion-family exclusive mod (+90% crit damage, energy orbs off Cold-killed enemies), rotates through Nightwave's Cred Offerings for 20 Creds.

disclosures.title: the 60% chase is optional
disclosures.body: One player who maxed every Kuva and Tenet weapon logged 790 adversaries and ~1,185 hours and explicitly said not to copy him. Take the first Glaxion you get, apply an Elemental Vice, and stop.
